verdict.rationale: Motion explicitly advertises combining multiple calendar accounts (Outlook, Google, iCloud) into a single interface so scheduling reflects busy time across all of them, directly matching the story's need for busy-block sync between work and personal calendars. This is corroborated by the live, documented API and auto-reshuffling scheduling engine, though all evidence is vendor-sourced. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that busy blocks actually sync bidirectionally and reliably in practice across separate work/personal accounts.
